data.body: SC-DD-AMENDMENT (sc-5 HTTP-400 path): The HTTP-400 / invalid-query stderr signal is currently only in a Consideration on this story, not a DD. SC-5 requires it literally as a peer to the zero-results stderr signal. When implementing this story, add as a DD: confluence-researcher detects HTTP 400 responses from the CQL search endpoint and emits the literal stderr signal '[confluence-research: invalid query...error: 400]' AND returns successfully (zero references, non-fatal) so the calling skill continues to the next step. Add a unit test asserting both the 400-path message format and the exit-0 behavior. Keep the zero-results and HTTP-400 stderr signals distinct so log readers can tell them apart. Other HTTP error codes (401, 403, 5xx) are out of scope here — file follow-ons if needed. Source: 2026-05-20 preplanning remediation against epic e471-dda3 SC↔DD coverage analysis.
